purpose: Contract for the distribution gateway to select only an authorised route.

decision.CLEAR: route may be selected if technical health checks pass
decision.PARTNER_ONLY: route requires the named authorised partner
decision.RESTRICTED: do not select until restriction is resolved
decision.REVIEW_REQUIRED: do not select until rights/regulatory review is cleared

technical_failover: Only between routes that independently pass the same rights gate.
security: No client-side flag can override the gate.
audit: Record decision, content, territory, route, rights source and timestamp.
